aurora.description: Main settings for the aurora background effect - the flowing, animated gradient in the background

colors.description: Color configuration for the aurora effect in different theme modes

light.description: Colors for light mode. Uses CSS variables from globals.css. The aurora transitions between these colors: start → middle → end

dark.description: Colors for dark mode. Can be set differently from light mode to achieve different effects in dark/light themes

animation.description: Controls how the aurora effect moves and animates

details.duration: Time in seconds for one complete animation cycle. Higher = slower movement
details.timing: How the animation progresses: 'linear' = smooth constant speed, 'ease-in-out' = smooth start/end
details.iterationCount: How many times the animation plays. 'infinite' = never stops

timing: ease - Slow start, fast middle, slow end

gradient.description: Controls how the gradient looks and behaves

stops.description: Position of color transitions in percentages. Creates the smooth blend between colors. Closer numbers = sharper transitions

size.description: Size of the gradient in percentage. Larger numbers create slower, more subtle movements. Smaller numbers = faster, more dramatic

effects.description: Visual effects applied to the aurora

blur.description: How much blur to apply. Higher numbers = softer, more ethereal look. Lower numbers = sharper, more defined edges

opacity.description: How visible the aurora is. 0 = invisible, 100 = fully visible. Around 70 gives a subtle effect that doesn't overwhelm content

blend.description: How the aurora mixes with the background. 'soft-light' gives a gentle blend, 'screen' would be more vibrant

overlays.description: Additional visual layers that add texture to the background

grid.description: A subtle grid pattern that adds structure. Very low opacity (5%) keeps it subtle but adds depth

noise.description: Adds a fine grain texture that makes the background feel less digital and more natural

performance.description: Settings that affect how smoothly the background runs

optimizations.description: Technical settings that help the browser render the animation smoothly. Generally shouldn't need changing

performance.details: These settings tell browsers what to optimize. Only change if you notice performance issues

positioning.description: Controls how the background is positioned on the page

details.zIndex: Ensures background stays behind content. -10 puts it behind most elements
details.inset: Slight negative value ensures no gaps at edges when scrolling
